h: Three Shabbos Meals From Creation to Completion

p: Behold, the three prayers of Shabbos
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בִּתְפִלּוֹת יוֹם טוֹב
which is not so with the prayers of Yom Tov,
which are all in one text;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הַסְּעוּדוֹת שֶׁל יוֹם טוֹב
which is not so with the meals of Yom Tov.
For it says in the Abudraham
about the three prayers of Shabbos:
from the holiness of the Shabbos of Creation;
הוּא קְדוּשַּׁת שַׁבָּת שֶׁל מַתַּן תּוֹרָה
is the holiness of the Shabbos of the giving of the Torah;
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion," etc.,
he brought down in his hand."
הוּא קְדוּשַּׁת שַׁבָּת שֶׁל עוֹלָם הַבָּא
is the holiness of the Shabbos of Olam HaBa,
"You are One and Your Name is One."
of the three meals of Shabbos.
corresponds to the holiness of the Shabbos of Creation,
"And on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed,"
is called "of the Field of Apples,"
which are the souls of Yisrael
who rejoice in the good gift
of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
that is, he was holy from the womb,
the aspect of the Shabbos of the giving of the Torah;
immediately at the beginning of Creation,
through their being destined to receive
עַל פָּסוּק יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי (שַׁבָּת פח, א)
that all the work of Creation was
until the day of the giving of the Torah:
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him;
for the two thousand years of Torah
begin from Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him;
עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע אַבְרָהָם בְּקוֹלִי וְגוֹ׳
"Because Avraham listened to My voice," etc.,
And it says in the Midrash
that the Holy One, blessed is He, prepared for him
הוּא נֶגֶד שַׁבָּת שֶׁל עוֹלָם הַבָּא
corresponds to the Shabbos of Olam HaBa;
as it says in the holy Zohar:
"for in it a soul is added,
which is the completion of all,
and it is the aspect of Yaakov,
who is the completion of the Avos,
of the holiness of his soul,
when there will be the completeness of Creation
And as we have already spoken of this,
that the soul of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the main addition of the extra soul,
flows to the souls of Yisrael
the mitzvah of Shabbos according to its law.
the Holy One, blessed is He, gives a person
and at the departure of Shabbos
from the pasuk 'He rested and was refreshed — vayinafash':
woe, the soul — nefesh — is lost."
which is like the World to Come,
according to the allusion of which we spoke above.

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 31:17 — “ביני ובין בני ישראל אות הוא לעלם כי ששת ימים עשה יהוה את השמים ואת הארץ וביום השביעי שבת וינפש” — “it shall be a sign for all time between Me and the people of Israel. For in six days יהוה made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day [God] ceased from work and was refreshed.”
